name: project-memory
description: Local project decisions, evidence and outcomes with bounded MCP retrieval.

interface.shortDescription: Reuse project evidence and inspect decision history.
interface.longDescription: Keep decisions, evidence, outcomes and reviewed lessons in local SQLite. Retrieve bounded context and inspect a live local HTML viewer or offline exports.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Project Memory for this project. Retrieve relevant evidence, preserve conditions and record decisions and outcomes explicitly.
